The '''Red Light Sector''' was a section of the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces established an Imperial-free Red Light Sector as their base of operations.
